organizeNoteId.label: Organize Note
organizeNoteId.description: The note that displays the Organize triage UI. Selecting it converts that note into a render note pointing at the Organize page; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

morningTime.label: Morning
morningTime.description: Time (HH:mm) the Organize "Morning" button sets on a task's start date.
